00045 const float NeuralNodeSimpleInternal::defaultWeight = 0.1;

00050 NeuralNodeSimpleInternal::NeuralNodeSimpleInternal(const int numWeights) throw()
00051 :   threshold(zero), output(zero), //input(zero), act(zero),

00058 void NeuralNodeSimpleInternal::init(const float weightMaximum) throw()
00059 {
00060     threshold = random.nextBiLinearDouble(weightMaximum);
00061     
00062     for(int i = 0; i < weightVector.size(); i++)
00063     {
00064         weightVector[i] = random.nextBiLinearDouble(weightMaximum);
00065     }   
00066 }

00068 void NeuralNodeSimpleInternal::randomise(const float amount) throw()
00069 {
00070     threshold += random.nextBiLinearDouble(amount);
00071     
00072     for(int i = 0; i < weightVector.size(); i++)
00073     {
00074         weightVector[i] += random.nextBiLinearDouble(amount);
00075     }

00103 float NeuralNodeSimpleInternal::propogate(NumericalArray<float> const& inputVector) throw()
00104 {
00105     float input = zero;
00106     
00107     const float* inputVectorPtr = inputVector.getArray();
00108     const float* weightVectorPtr = weightVector.getArray();
00109     
00110     const int size = weightVector.size();
00111     for(int i = 0; i < size; i++)
00112     {
00113         input += inputVectorPtr[i] * weightVectorPtr[i];
00114     }   
00115     
00116     float act = input + threshold;
00117     output = one / (one + (float)ugen::pow(ne1, -act));
00118     
00119     return output;
00120 }
00121 
00122 void NeuralNodeSimpleInternal::backProp(NumericalArray<float> const& inputVector, 
00123                                         const float error, const float actFuncOffset, const float learnRate, 
00124                                         NumericalArray<float>& adjustVector) throw()
00125 {
00126     float output = this->output;
00127     float adjust = error * (actFuncOffset + (output * (one-output)));
00128     float learn = adjust * learnRate;
00129     
00130     float* weightVectorPtr = weightVector.getArray();
00131     float* adjustVectorPtr = adjustVector.getArray();
00132     const float* inputVectorPtr = inputVector.getArray();
00133     
00134     const int size = weightVector.size();
00135     for(int i = 0; i < size; i++)
00136     {
00137         weightVectorPtr[i] += inputVectorPtr[i] * learn;
00138         adjustVectorPtr[i] += weightVectorPtr[i] * adjust;
00139     }
00140     
00141     threshold += learn;
00142 }
